clause_title: RENT AND DEPOSIT
clause_text: The Lessee shall pay a monthly rent of INR 45,000 payable on or before 5th of each English calendar month, along with an interest-free refundable security deposit of INR 2,50,000.

clause_title: ESCALATION CLAUSE
clause_text: Upon completion of 11 months, if renewed by mutual consent, the monthly rent shall automatically increase by 10% per annum.

clause_title: UNILATERAL TERMINATION & FORFEITURE
clause_text: Lessor reserves unconditional right to terminate tenancy with 7 days notice without cause and forfeit 50% deposit if premise is vacated before lock-in.

clause_title: MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS
clause_text: Lessee shall bear all internal minor repair costs up to INR 2,000 while major structural repairs remain Lessor's responsibility under Transfer of Property Act.

clause_title: INDEMNIFICATION
clause_text: Lessee agrees to unconditionally indemnify and hold Lessor harmless against any structural damages, neighbor disputes, or municipal violations arising during occupancy.

clause_title: CONSIDERATION AND CONVEYANCE
clause_text: The Vendor acknowledges receipt of the full sale consideration of INR 85,00,000 via RTGS and transfers absolute freehold ownership to Purchaser.

clause_title: FREE FROM ENCUMBRANCE
clause_text: The Vendor covenants that the Schedule Property is free from all mortgages, liens, lis pendens, attachment, prior agreements, or statutory tax arrears.

clause_title: INDEMNITY AGAINST DEFECTIVE TITLE
clause_text: The Vendor hereby covenants to keep the Purchaser fully indemnified against any loss, claim, or defect in title discovered within statutory limitation period.

clause_title: POSSESSION AND TAXES
clause_text: Vendor has handed over peaceful vacant physical possession along with original title documents, mother deeds, and municipal tax receipts.

clause_title: LOCK-IN PERIOD
clause_text: The Lessee shall strictly adhere to a mandatory 36-month non-terminable lock-in period. If Lessee vacates early, Lessee is liable to pay the entire remaining rent for the balance period.

clause_title: UNLIMITED INDEMNITY
clause_text: Lessee shall hold Lessor harmless and provide unlimited indemnification against all regulatory penalties, employee actions, or property losses regardless of fault.

clause_title: DISPUTE RESOLUTION
clause_text: All disputes shall be referred to a sole arbitrator unilaterally appointed by the Lessor, with seat of arbitration exclusively in New Delhi.

clause_title: PAYMENT SCHEDULE & DELAY PENALTY
clause_text: Allottee must pay installments per construction milestones. Any delay in payment attracts 18% per annum compound penal interest.

clause_title: POSSESSION TIMELINE
clause_text: Promoter endeavors to deliver possession within 36 months, with an unconditional 12-month grace period and force majeure defense.

clause_title: ASYMMETRIC COMPENSATION
clause_text: In case of promoter delay beyond grace period, compensation is capped strictly at INR 5 per sq ft per month, waiving all other statutory damages under RERA.

clause_title: VEHICLE PARTICULARS & CONSIDERATION
clause_text: Seller transfers Hyundai Creta 2021 model (Chassis: ME1234, Engine: EN9876) for agreed consideration of INR 6,75,000 received in full.

clause_title: RTO TRANSFER & STATUTORY RESPONSIBILITY
clause_text: Buyer covenants to submit Form 29, 30, and 28 (NOC) to Regional Transport Office (RTO) within 14 days and transfer Registration Certificate.

clause_title: ACCIDENT & TRAFFIC CHALLAN INDEMNITY
clause_text: From the exact date and hour of physical delivery (05-May-2024, 14:00 hrs), Buyer assumes full civil, criminal, and motor accident tribunal (MACT) liabilities.

clause_title: WARRANTY DISCLAIMER (AS-IS WHERE-IS)
clause_text: Vehicle is sold on strictly 'As-Is-Where-Is' basis with no express or implied warranty on mechanical or electrical condition.

clause_title: HYPOTHECATION & FIRST CHARGE
clause_text: Borrower creates exclusive first hypothecation charge over Tata Harrier SUV in favor of Bank, endorsed on RTO RC book under Motor Vehicles Act.

clause_title: UNILATERAL REPOSSESSION CLAUSE
clause_text: Upon default in payment of two consecutive EMIs, Bank shall have unfettered right to repossess the vehicle without court intervention or prior notice.

clause_title: PREPAYMENT PENALTY
clause_text: Prepayment or foreclosure within first 12 months is subject to 5% foreclosure fee plus applicable GST on outstanding principal balance.

clause_title: DEFAULT INTEREST & CHEQUE BOUNCE
clause_text: Delayed EMI attracts overdue penal interest of 24% per annum compounded monthly plus INR 750 bounce charges per dishonored NACH mandate.

clause_title: FLEET LEASE CHARGES
clause_text: Lessee shall pay monthly lease rental of INR 30,000 per commercial van against monthly tax invoices.

clause_title: MILEAGE CAPPING & PENALTY
clause_text: Monthly usage is capped at 3,500 km per vehicle. Any excess kilometer run will be billed at punitive rate of INR 9.50 per km.

clause_title: INSURANCE & ACCIDENTAL CLAIMS
clause_text: Lessee must maintain comprehensive commercial motor insurance with zero-depreciation rider and pay deductible fees on all damage claims.

clause_title: SANCTION AND DISBURSEMENT
clause_text: Bank sanctions term loan of INR 50,00,000 repayable in 60 equated monthly installments with interest reset on quarterly basis linked to RBI Repo Rate.

clause_title: CROSS-DEFAULT AND ACCELERATION
clause_text: Any default by Borrower or its directors in any other credit facility across any financial institution triggers instant acceleration and total recall of this loan.

clause_title: SARFAESI ENFORCEMENT & ASSET ATTACHMENT
clause_text: Upon classification of account as Non-Performing Asset (NPA), Bank is entitled to enforce security under Section 13(2) of SARFAESI Act 2002 without court decree.

clause_title: MATERIAL ADVERSE CHANGE (MAC)
clause_text: Bank reserves right to demand immediate full repayment if in Bank's sole judgment any material adverse change occurs in Borrower's financial health.

clause_title: PERSONAL GUARANTEE OF DIRECTORS
clause_text: Managing Director executes unconditional, irrevocable, joint and several continuing personal guarantee covering all dues and enforcement expenses.

clause_title: LOAN DISBURSEMENT & TENURE
clause_text: Personal loan amount of INR 7,50,000 disbursed directly to Borrower's savings account, repayable over 36 equated monthly installments of INR 25,085.

clause_title: CREDIT REPORTING & RECOVERY AGENTS
clause_text: Borrower consents to sharing delinquency data with Credit Information Companies (CIBIL/Equifax) and engagement of third-party recovery agencies as per RBI Fair Practices Code.

clause_title: JURISDICTION & ARBITRATION
clause_text: Disputes shall be settled by arbitration in Mumbai under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996, with borrower submitting to exclusive jurisdiction of Mumbai courts.

clause_title: LOAN FACILITY & INTEREST REVISED
clause_text: Lender provides home loan facility of INR 65,00,000 at floating interest rate linked to External Benchmark Lending Rate (EBLR).

clause_title: DEPOSIT OF TITLE DEEDS
clause_text: Borrower deposits original registered sale deed, parent documents, and occupancy certificate creating constructive equitable mortgage under Transfer of Property Act.

clause_title: MANDATORY PROPERTY INSURANCE
clause_text: Borrower shall keep mortgaged apartment comprehensively insured against fire, earthquake, and structural damage with Bank assigned as sole loss payee.

clause_title: PLEDGE OF ORNAMENTS & PURITY APPRAISAL
clause_text: Borrower pledges 72 grams net 22-Karat gold ornaments appraised and sealed in tamper-proof pouch in Borrower's presence.

clause_title: MARGIN CALL & MARKET FLUCTUATION
clause_text: If market price of gold drops and Loan-to-Value (LTV) exceeds 75% as per RBI guidelines, Borrower must pay margin money within 14 days of notice.

clause_title: PUBLIC AUCTION & RECOVERY
clause_text: Upon failure to redeem within 12 months or failure to meet margin call, Lender possesses unconditional right to sell gold via public auction to recover principal and penal interest.

clause_title: SAFE CUSTODY & INDEMNITY
clause_text: Lender's liability for pledged gold in case of burglary or fire is strictly limited to standard insurance settlement value, excluding emotional or antique worth.

clause_title: AGRICULTURAL CONCESSIONAL FACILITY
clause_text: Credit facility of INR 1,80,000 sanctioned for seasonal crop cultivation against pledge of verified gold articles.

clause_title: PROMPT REPAYMENT SUBVENTION
clause_text: Borrower is eligible for 3% interest subvention from Central Government provided entire loan with interest is cleared within 365 days of disbursement.

clause_title: RE-VALUATION CLAUSE
clause_text: Bank reserves right to re-appraise ornaments at Borrower's expense through certified bank goldsmith if any dispute arises regarding carats or purity.

clause_title: BULLET PAYMENT & STEPPING INTEREST
clause_text: Entire principal and interest must be paid at end of 6 months. Failure to service interest monthly steps up interest rate to 27% p.a. retrospectively.

clause_title: EXPEDITED 7-DAY AUCTION NOTICE
clause_text: Lender may issue 7-day SMS notice to registered mobile number prior to auctioning gold at local district auction center.

clause_title: SURPLUS & DEFICIT ADJUSTMENT
clause_text: Auction proceeds shall be appropriated first towards legal/auction expenses, then penal interest, then principal. Borrower remains liable for any deficit.

clause_title: UNILATERAL RENT HIKE
clause_text: The Lessor shall have the absolute right to increase the monthly rent by up to 25% at any time during the tenancy with only 3 days written notice.

clause_title: NON-REFUNDABLE CAUTION DEPOSIT
clause_text: The entire security deposit of INR 3,00,000 shall be treated as non-refundable caution fee in the event the Lessee disputes any utility charge.

clause_title: WAIVER OF COURT ACCESS
clause_text: The Lessee unconditionally waives all statutory rights to approach civil courts or rent tribunals under the Rent Control Act.

clause_title: IMMEDIATE FORFEITURE OF DOWN PAYMENT
clause_text: If the buyer fails to pay the balance consideration within 48 hours, all token money and down payments shall stand completely forfeited without recourse.

clause_title: SURREPTITIOUS RECOVERY RIGHTS
clause_text: The lender is authorized to track, disable via GPS immobilizer, and forcibly seize the vehicle from any public or private parking without court order.

clause_title: COMPOUND PENAL INTEREST OF 36%
clause_text: Any defaulted installment shall attract punitive compound penal charges at 36% per annum calculated on daily balance until complete cure.

clause_title: UNCHECKED RIGHT TO APPOINT RECEIVER
clause_text: Lender may appoint any third-party agency as administrative receiver to seize borrower's commercial revenues without prior judicial approval.

clause_title: INSTANT AUCTION WITHOUT POSTAL DISPATCH
clause_text: Pledgee company reserves absolute power to melt or auction pledged ornaments if margin shortfall is not settled within 48 hours of automated SMS dispatch.

clause_title: COMPLETE WAIVER OF LOSS LIABILITY
clause_text: Company disclaims all liability for total loss, stone breakage, or substitute valuation during transit or safe storage.

clause_title: RESTORATION CHARGES DEDUCTION
clause_text: Lessor shall deduct flat 1 month rent from security deposit towards routine painting and deep cleaning upon vacation irrespective of actual premises condition.

clause_title: RESTRICTIVE GUEST POLICY
clause_text: Lessee shall not permit overnight guests for more than 3 consecutive days without prior written consent of the association and Lessor.

clause_title: DELAYED NOC TRANSMISSION
clause_text: Seller shall provide RTO Form 28 NOC within 60 days of full payment; until then buyer operates vehicle under temporary delivery note.

clause_title: PARTS WEAR AND TEAR SHARING
clause_text: Wear and tear costs of tires, brake pads, and battery during test period shall be shared 50:50 between buyer and seller.

clause_title: ANNUAL COVENANT AUDIT FEES
clause_text: Borrower shall bear all annual legal audit and collateral inspection fees determined by the Bank's empaneled valuer.

clause_title: RESTRICTION ON DIRECTORS DIVIDENDS
clause_text: Borrower entity shall not declare dividends or issue shares to directors if debt service coverage ratio drops below 1.5.

clause_title: PACKING AND APPRAISAL CHARGES
clause_text: A non-refundable ornament testing fee of 1.5% and vault insurance surcharge of INR 500 shall be deducted upfront from loan sanction.

clause_title: PARTIAL REDEMPTION RESTRICTIONS
clause_text: Borrower cannot redeem individual items in the packet until the entire composite loan facility with accrued interest is fully settled.

clause_title: MUTUAL TERMINATION NOTICE
clause_text: Either party may terminate this agreement by providing one calendar month written notice or rent in lieu thereof.

clause_title: ELECTRICITY & WATER USAGE
clause_text: Lessee shall pay monthly electricity and water meter charges directly to the utility supply authority as per government tariff rates.

clause_title: RECEIPT OF KEYS AND PEACEFUL ENJOYMENT
clause_text: Lessor guarantees peaceful and uninterrupted quiet enjoyment of the premises to Lessee during the subsistence of this tenancy.

clause_title: RECEIPT OF ORIGINAL VEHICLE INVOICE
clause_text: Seller hands over original road tax token, PUC certificate, and insurance policy transferred in favor of Buyer.

clause_title: TRANSFER FEE RESPONSIBILITY
clause_text: All official government RTO transfer fees and smart card charges shall be borne equally by Buyer and Seller.

clause_title: STANDARD GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL
clause_text: Borrower may escalate unresolved banking complaints to the Principal Nodal Officer or the RBI Banking Ombudsman under RBI Scheme 2021.

clause_title: PROMPT STATEMENT TRANSMISSION
clause_text: Bank shall furnish monthly loan account statements reflecting breakdown of principal, interest, and outstanding balance via email.

clause_title: SEALED POUCH NUMBERING
clause_text: All pledged ornaments shall be weighed in front of customer, recorded with barcode sticker, and preserved in dual-custody bank locker.

clause_title: REFUND OF SURPLUS AUCTION PROCEEDS
clause_text: Any excess monetary surplus realized from auction after clearing legal dues shall be credited to Borrower's bank account within 30 days.
